summary: Fully tested Vendor Manual Order (non-corporate walk-in). Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass — customer-types list (5 seeded), admin CRUD + RBAC 403, happy-path punch returns 200 with ₹280/paid/CRV-code, appears in /api/orders with is_manual=true + customer_type='Guest', unknown type → 400, cross-site site_id → 403, master admin punch → 403, and sales report (2026-06-01→2026-12-31) rolls up under 'MO Client'/'MO Vendor'. Frontend: /vendor/manual-order loads, Navbar 'Manual Order' link visible, 5 customer-type chips render, submit disabled until BOTH a type is picked AND items are added, +/- steppers work, live total updates to ₹280.00, Complete Order produces receipt with collection code CRV-303132 and total ₹280.00, and New Manual Order resets state. UI is clean, responsive, well-aligned.
critical_code_review_comments: orders.py _get_customer_types() lazy-seeds defaults on empty — good, idempotent via $setOnInsert.
create_manual_order correctly forces vendor role + site scoping (rejects unassigned site_id with 403).
Manual orders bypass PAYMENT_MODE gating by design (counter QR) — documented and safe: mark_paid=True path sets payment_status='paid' + paid_by=vendor email at insert time.
ManualOrder.js: cart state keyed by menu_item_id with delete-on-zero — clean; total is a simple reduce so it stays consistent with the server-validated price on submit.
